raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

**What goes wrong**
#47408 restricted the Quark MXFP4 W4A16 MoE path to gfx1151. On any other consumer RDNA GPU (gfx11xx, gfx1200, gfx1201) the gate is now false, so `process_weights_after_loading` falls into the AITER branch and calls `e8m0_shuffle`, which is only imported when `_use_aiter` is set. Without aiter the server fails at startup with `NameError: name 'e8m0_shuffle' is not defined`. The same applies to `moe_shuffle_scale` on gfx1250 when aiter is off, and to `SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16=0`.

**Where it shows up**
Every consumer RDNA GPU other than gfx1151. Reported by @vivienfanghuagood on gfx1201 (RDNA4, 32 GB, ROCm 7.2.3, no aiter): before #47408 the W4A16 path served amd/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-MXFP4; after it, startup fails with the NameError. gfx942 and gfx1250 (MI455) must keep the AITER path.

**How to fix**
Gate the W4A16 path on consumer RDNA again (`gfx11*` and `gfx120*`, not `gfx12*` because gfx1250 also matches), inlined so this does not depend on #47254. In the non-W4A16 branch, raise a clear "requires aiter" error when `_use_aiter` is false instead of falling through to the NameError.

## Modifications

- `quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.py`: replace `_is_gfx1151` with `_is_consumer_rdna = gcnArchName.split(":")[0].startswith(("gfx11", "gfx120"))`; `_use_triton_w4a16` keys on it. gfx1250 and gfx942 stay on AITER.
- `quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe.py`: `process_weights_after_loading` raises a `RuntimeError` ("requires aiter") at the top of the non-W4A16 branch when `_use_aiter` is false.
- Update the gate comment, the W4A16 `info_once` message, and the `SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16` comment in `environ.py` so they no longer say gfx1151 only.
- `test_quark_w4a4_mxfp4_moe_w4a16.py`: gate cases gfx1100 / gfx1151 / gfx1200 / gfx1201 on, gfx942 / gfx1250 off, and the env switch off on gfx1151 and gfx1201. The EP, -1 bucket and SwiGLU tests are architecture independent and unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

The W4A16 compute path is unchanged; only the gate that selects it changes. Measured by @vivienfanghuagood on an equivalent gate (`startswith(("gfx11", "gfx1200", "gfx1201"))`, same behavior as this PR's `("gfx11", "gfx120")` on all current archs), amd/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-MXFP4, tp=1, `--context-length 8192`, no aiter, Triton 3.7.0 + triton-kernels 1.0.0, sgl-eval gsm8k, 100 questions, thinking off, T=0.7. 100 questions is about +/-5 points of noise.

| GPU | main before #47408 | #47408 | #47408 + gate widening |
|---|---|---|---|
| gfx1201 (RDNA4) | 57% | NameError at startup | 61% |
| gfx1100 (RDNA3) | 55% | NameError at startup | 58% |

The `requires aiter` guard and the exact gate expression in this PR were not run on a GPU by the author.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Same setup and runs as above, separate server processes (c1 / c8 tok/s):

| GPU | main before #47408 | #47408 | #47408 + gate widening |
|---|---|---|---|
| gfx1201 (RDNA4) | 31.8 / 246.9 | NameError at startup | 31.1 / 237.6 |
| gfx1100 (RDNA3) | 17.0 / 192.4 | NameError at startup | 16.5 / 174.2 |

gfx1100 c8 is 9.5% below the pre-#47408 run, more than the other three deltas (-2% to -4%); whether that is noise or an effect of the #47408 EP changes was not isolated.

Unit tests (#47408's test file plus the new gate cases): 7 passed on both cards, including the two EP cases.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the PR flow. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`, `/tag-and-rerun-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls to merge.

@@ -1091,7 +1091,8 @@ class Envs:
     # decode without runtime permutes.
     SGLANG_AITER_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT = EnvStr("nhd")
     # Run Quark MXFP4 (W4A4) MoE checkpoints as W4A16 via triton_kernels on
-    # gfx1151 (Strix Halo), which has no FP4 hardware or AITER FP4 MoE kernel.
+    # consumer RDNA (gfx11 / gfx120, e.g. gfx1151 Strix Halo, gfx1201), which has
+    # no FP4 hardware or AITER FP4 MoE kernel. gfx1250 stays on AITER.
     SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16 = EnvBool(True)
     SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA = EnvBool(False)
     # Send Qwen3.8's 512-expert softmax router back to aiter `fused_topk`

@@ -127,13 +127,16 @@ def loader(param, loaded_weight, weight_name, shard_id, expert_id, *args, **kw):
 
 OCP_MX_BLOCK_SIZE = 32
 
-# gfx1151 (Strix Halo) has neither FP4 hardware nor an AITER FP4 MoE kernel, so
-# the AITER path cannot run there: its scales are laid out for gfx950 and its
-# kernels produce garbage. Run the MoE as W4A16 instead: keep the packed MXFP4
-# weights and upcast them inside triton_kernels' matmul, with bf16 activations.
+# Consumer RDNA (gfx11 and gfx120, e.g. gfx1100 / gfx1151 Strix Halo / gfx1201)
+# has neither FP4 hardware nor an AITER FP4 MoE kernel, so the AITER path cannot
+# run there: its scales are laid out for gfx950 and its kernels produce garbage.
+# Run the MoE as W4A16 instead: keep the packed MXFP4 weights and upcast them
+# inside triton_kernels' matmul, with bf16 activations.
 # SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16=0 opts out.
-_is_gfx1151 = _is_hip and "gfx1151" in torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName
-_use_triton_w4a16 = _is_gfx1151 and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16.get()
+_arch = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName.split(":")[0] if _is_hip else ""
+# gfx120, not gfx12: gfx1250 (MI455) also starts with gfx12 and must stay on AITER.
+_is_consumer_rdna = _arch.startswith(("gfx11", "gfx120"))
+_use_triton_w4a16 = _is_consumer_rdna and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16.get()
 _TRITON_W4A16_NUM_WARPS = 8
 
 
@@ -984,6 +987,13 @@ def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
         if _use_triton_w4a16:
             self._process_weights_triton_w4a16(layer)
             return
+        if not _use_aiter:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Quark MXFP4 MoE weight post-processing requires aiter on this "
+                "device (set SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 and install aiter). Consumer RDNA "
+                "(gfx11 / gfx120) uses the W4A16 triton path unless "
+                "SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16=0."
+            )
         if not getattr(self, "_owns_moe_weight_layout", False):
             raise RuntimeError(
                 "Quark MXFP4 weight preshuffling requires a backend that owns "
@@ -1201,7 +1211,7 @@ def _process_weights_triton_w4a16(self, layer: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
                 f"The W4A16 triton path does not support SwiGLU variants: {unsupported}"
             )
         logger.info_once(
-            "Quark MXFP4 MoE on gfx1151: no FP4 hardware, running the W4A4 MXFP4 "
+            "Quark MXFP4 MoE on consumer RDNA: no FP4 hardware, running the W4A4 MXFP4 "
             "checkpoint as W4A16 (bf16 activations, MXFP4 weights upcast in "
             "triton_kernels). Set SGLANG_ENABLE_QUARK_MXFP4_MOE_W4A16=0 to disable."
         )

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
-"""Quark MXFP4 MoE W4A16 (triton_kernels) path on gfx1151.
+"""Quark MXFP4 MoE W4A16 (triton_kernels) path on consumer RDNA.
 
-The path must only replace the AITER path on gfx1151; other AMD GPUs keep AITER.
+The path must only replace the AITER path on consumer RDNA (gfx11 / gfx120);
+other AMD GPUs, including gfx1250, keep AITER.
 With EP > 1 the dispatcher maps experts owned by other ranks to -1; the W4A16
 path must drop those slots instead of indexing with -1 (a GPU memory fault).
 """

     def test_gfx942_keeps_the_aiter_path(self):
         self.assertFalse(_w4a16_enabled_on("gfx942:sramecc+:xnack-"))
 
-    def test_gfx1151_uses_the_w4a16_path(self):
-        self.assertTrue(_w4a16_enabled_on("gfx1151"))
